# Apex Collision Center
> Independent auto repair shop in North York, Ontario for all makes and models. Upfront quotes, honest diagnosis, quality parts.

Apex Collision Center at 4544 Dufferin Street, North York, ON M3H 5X2 handles maintenance and repair for domestic, Asian and European vehicles. Open Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, closed Sunday. Phone (289) 544-2727, email mustafa@apexcollisioncenter.ca.
